newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Menem sees 1997 GDP up at least 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Menem sees 1997 GDP up at least 8 pct.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem forecast Tuesday that the economy would grow by "at least" eight percent in 1997 after climbing 4.6 percent last year.
"In the last six months we grew at a rate of eight percent and we will at least maintain that figure for the whole year," Menem said.
Private analysts forecast growth at 6-7 percent.
Menem's comments came during a speech scheduled to address the government's plans to attack 16.1 percent unemployment and high poverty.
